# Project-authored Keynote no-op control

These exact retained PPTX bytes derive from this repository's MIT-licensed synthetic sixteen-slide Arial qualification fixture, generated by `scripts/keynote-qualification/` at commit `4a3d32ea5fb870bbae574974f4e1c19dda00549b`. The root session imported the baseline into Keynote 15.1.1 on macOS, saved a fresh Keynote document and exported a fresh PPTX on 2026-10-15. The native export contains only the project's authored text, notes and synthetic image/chart/table controls. It is retained as read-only regression input under the repository MIT license; it is not a claim of general native acceptance.

`manifest.json` records exact file sizes and SHA-256 hashes. The maintained no-op test reads these files directly and does not require machine-local transfers, Keynote, PowerPoint, fonts or network access. Do not regenerate or rewrite them to make a test pass.

The export moves literal footer objects before authored text in XML paint order, strips their `ftr` placeholder role while retaining their exact object names, empties slide-number field caches and removes the notes-page slide-number fields. Authored body words and speaker notes remain ordered and unchanged. The current importer incorrectly returns the literal footer as a content block. The comparator records the notes-field topology loss and imported furniture gap separately; neither is hidden by text sorting or a cached-source replay.
